info.name: Read Excel file
info.description: Turn selected excel tables into JSON datastructures

outPorts.name: out
outPorts.desc: The selected Excel tables as (possibly nested) JSON datastructures.

sheets_to_load.desc: Names of sheets to read dynamically. Their columns are read generically and the resulting sub-object is attached based on the key columns present in the sheet: PLTID(+TREAT_ID+EID) -> plot, TREAT_ID(+EID) -> treatment, EID -> experiment. The sub-object key is the lower-cased sheet name. If the key columns are unique per row a single object is stored, otherwise a list of rows is stored.

load_all.desc: If True, automatically reads every sheet.

index_of_header_row.desc: The row number (starting at 0), which should be used for the header names.

nesting_by_key_cols.desc:
When set, specifies which nesting levels to create according to these keys in the header columns.
        E.g. {
            "experiments": ["EID"],
            "treatments": ["EID", "TREAT_ID"],
            "plots": ["EID", "TREAT_ID", "PLTID"],
        }
        This will create nested dictionaries if columns with these keys exist.

send_nesting_level.desc: Send messages at this nesting level, e.g. ['EID', 'TREAT_ID'].

include_branch_level_data.desc:
If send nesting is not empty, then if set to true sends the data at the branch level, before
        traversing down the nesting level as extra message.
        If there is no nested sending requested, just one message with all data will be send.

include_brackets_when_sending_nested.desc: Add a bracket IP pair around each nesting level.

debug.desc: If True, print debug information to the console.

info.name: Wrap IPs into substream
info.description: Wrap a set of incoming IPs into a substream.

inPorts.desc: Optional side-channel of open-/close-bracket IPs (e.g. from a 'Split bracketed stream' component) dictating substream boundaries. If unconnected, 'no_of_ips' controls wrapping as usual. If connected, an open-bracket received here is forwarded to 'out', 'in' IPs are then forwarded until a matching close-bracket is received here; its 'substream_length' (common.capnp:Value(ui64)) attribute determines how many 'in' IPs belong to the substream.

outPorts.name: out
outPorts.desc: Substream wrapped IPs received on 'in' port.

no_of_ips.desc:
Number of IPs to wrap into substream. 0 means wrap all IPs and wait for upstream port to close.
        An incoming substream counts as one IP!

info.name: Update JSON
info.description: Update JSON datastructures.

inPorts.name: in
inPorts.desc:
JSON text which is supposed to be updated and changed. Is substream sensitive, meaning if the
            'attrs' port is connected one IP from 'attrs' will be applied to all the IPs in the substream.

inPorts.name: attrs
inPorts.desc:
If connected, then for each message received on 'attrs', the attributes and the content of that message
            will be made available to the component as '@attrs' for the content of the message and
            each attribute as '@attrs_{attr_name}', if any. By default the used name will be
            the ports name ('attrs'), unless it has been renamed via the config option 'name_for_attrs_port'.

outPorts.name: out
outPorts.desc: The updated JSON text.

types.desc: Define the loadable type the attribute being referenced has.

attr_sub_access_separator.desc: The token to be used to separate path names for accessing sub-objects, e.g. @attr_object/sub1/sub2.

update.desc: Mapping of update operations to perform on the JSON structure. Structure and description have to match.

replace.desc: Mapping of replacement operations to perform on the JSON structure.

add.desc: Mapping of addition operations to perform on the JSON structure.

name_for_attrs_port.desc:
The content of a message received on the 'attrs' port will be made available under that name
        for the updates as an attribute. By default this will be the ports name, thus '@attrs'.

info.name: Filter JSON
info.description: Traverse JSON to a leaf and filter it by selected paths.

inPorts.name: in
inPorts.desc: Input JSON text to traverse and filter.

outPorts.name: out
outPorts.desc: Filtered JSON text.

traversal_path.desc: Optional path (e.g. 'obs_crop_daily_means' or 'root/items/0') from the input JSON root to the leaf structure that should be filtered.

path_separator.desc: Separator used for traversal_path and filter_paths.

filter_paths.desc: List of paths to keep from each filtered item. Supports nested paths and list indices (e.g. ['DATE', 'stats/CWAD', '0/value']). Optional aliases can be provided as 'alias=path' (e.g. 'date=DATE').

values_only.desc: If true, return only values in the order of filter_paths instead of key/value objects. For a list leaf this results in a list of lists.

flatten_values_only_lists.desc: If true and values_only is true, flatten one list nesting level for list outputs. This turns list-of-lists into a single list.

info.name: Map JSON values
info.description: Map over JSON list items or object values and apply configured transformation operations.

inPorts.name: in
inPorts.desc: Input JSON as list, object, or atomic value.

outPorts.name: out
outPorts.desc: Transformed JSON.

operations.desc:
Ordered transformation operations applied to each list item, object value, or the top-level atomic input.
            Defined like: {"path": "key/key", "op": "round", "ndigits": 2}

max_abs_exponent.desc: Absolute exponent limit for pow operation.

on_error.desc: Error behavior for a message: keep_original forwards unmodified input, null forwards JSON null, drop_message skips output.

info.name: Interpolate JSON by key
info.description: Group JSON objects and interpolate y=f(x) at configured x positions.

inPorts.name: in
inPorts.desc: Input JSON containing or being a list of objects.

outPorts.name: out
outPorts.desc: Output list of grouped interpolated points as JSON text.

traversal_path.desc: Optional path from input root to list leaf that should be processed.

group_key.desc: Optional key used to split list items into groups (e.g. TREAT_ID).

x_key.desc: Key in each list item used as x-axis value.

y_key.desc: Key in each list item used as y-axis value.

inter_x.desc: Query x values at which interpolated y values are calculated.

extrapolation.desc: How to handle inter_x outside the observed x-range: null -> y is null, clamp -> boundary y, linear -> linearly extrapolate.

info.name: JSON to common Value
info.description: Convert JSON text into a common.capnp:Value with optional automatic type optimization.

inPorts.name: in
inPorts.desc: JSON text to convert to common.capnp:Value.

outPorts.name: out
outPorts.desc: Converted Value.

traversal_path.desc: Optional path from input root to the JSON value to convert.

requested_type.desc: Optional Value union field to force, e.g. lpair, lf64, li64, lt, lb, f64, i64, t, b. Set to null for automatic type selection.

auto_select_type.desc: Automatically pick a fitting Value type from the JSON input.

optimize_smallest_type.desc: When auto selecting, choose the smallest fitting numeric type if possible.

allow_fallback_if_requested_type_fails.desc: If requested_type is set but values do not fit, fallback to a fitting type (if possible). If false, skip the message.

null_sentinel.desc: Replacement value for JSON null in scalar/list conversions.

nan_sentinel.desc: Replacement value for NaN entries in float scalar/list conversions.

attach_sentinel_attributes.desc: Attach attributes describing sentinel values applied to outgoing messages.

null_sentinel_attr.desc: Attribute name for applied null sentinel value.

nan_sentinel_attr.desc: Attribute name for applied NaN sentinel value.

merge_substream_results.desc: If true, flatten first-level substreams by merging object results or concatenating array results, and emit one result message for each completed substream.

inPorts.desc: Receive MONICA JSON result.

types.desc: Define the loadable type the attribute being referenced has.

path_to_out_dir.desc: Use path_to_out_dir if no out_path_attr is available in metadata of IP.

out_path_attr.desc: If out_path_attr is available, don't use path_to_out_dir.

filepath_pattern.desc:
Replace {@id} to create the filename. @some_attr_name refers to an attribute.
        It's type has to be defined in the 'types' attribute. If no @ is in front of the name, it will be
        interpreted to be either the results "customId" stringified itself {customId} or if not 'customId' to be
        a subpath access in the 'customId' JSON object. If the {name} contains '/' it will be treated as
        a path in an object, where names will be keys in objects and numbers will be indizes in a list.

csv_delimiter.desc: Like ','. Use this string as delimiter for csv output.

info.description: Read the observed values for the calibration.

inPorts.name: country_ids
inPorts.desc: [1,2,3] :string of serialized json array containing country ids

outPorts.name: out
outPorts.desc: {country_id: {year: yield}} :string of json serialized mapping from country id to year to yield

crop.desc: crop to calibrate, e.g. maize | millet | sorghum

default_country_ids.desc: string of serialized json array containing country ids

info.name: Spotpy calibration component
info.description: The actual component in the center of the calibration flow.

inPorts.name: init_params
inPorts.desc: list of JSON objects describing the parameters to calibrate

inPorts.name: obs_values
inPorts.desc:
List of observations. If the list contains null or NaN sentinel values, these will be replaced with NaN.
            These sentinel values can be given as 'null_sentinel' and 'NaN_sentinel' attributes.

inPorts.name: sim_values
inPorts.desc:
List of simulated values. If the list contains null or NaN sentinel values, these will be replaced with NaN.
            These sentinel values can be given as 'null_sentinel' and 'NaN_sentinel' attributes.

outPorts.name: sampled_params
outPorts.desc: [Value.pair(name1, value1), Value.pair(name2, value2), ...] list of param_name -> sampled value pairs

outPorts.name: best
outPorts.desc: best optimized result

param_set_id.desc:
id for the parameterset to calibrate against.
        Might be set as attribute 'param_set_id' on observed values IP received on 'obs_values' port.

path_to_db_dir.desc:
If set path to directory where the calibration database will be created.
        If None, then a temporary directory will be created.

repetitions.desc:
Maximum number of function evaluations allowed during optimization.
        ROPE: (default: None) Number of runs overall, is only used if the user does
        not specify the other arguments, otherwise its overwritten.

ngs.desc:
SCE-UA: (default: 20) Number of complexes (sub-populations), take more than the number of analysed parameters.
        If None, then will be calculated as the 2*'the number of parameters'.

peps.desc:
SCE-UA: (default: 0.0000001) Value of the normalized geometric range of the parameters in the population below which convergence is deemed achieved.
        ABC: (default: 0.0001) mutation factor.
        FSCABC: (default: 0.0001) convergence criterion

pcento.desc: SCE-UA: (default: 0.0000001) The percentage change allowed in the past kstop loops below which convergence is assumed to be achieved.

kstop.desc: SCE-UA: (default: 100) The number of past evolution loops and their respective objective value to assess whether the marginal improvement at the current loop (in percentage) is less than pcento.

max_loop_inc.desc: SCE-UA: (default: None) Number of loops executed at max in this function call.

eb.desc:
ABC: (default: 48) number of employed bees (half of population size)
        FSCABC: (default: 48) number of employed bees (half of population size)

a.desc:
ABC: (default: 1/10) mutation factor
        FSCABC: (default: 1/10) mutation factor

ownlimit.desc: ABC: (default: false) determines if an userdefined limit is set or not.

limit.desc:
DDS: (default: 24) sets the limit
        FSCABC: (default: None) sets the limit for scout bee phase

trials.desc:
DDS: (default: 1) amount of runs DDS algorithm will be performed.
        PADDS (default: 1)

x_initial.desc: DDS: (default: []) set an initial trial set as a first parameter configuration. If the set is empty the algorithm select an own initial parameter configuration.

nChains.desc:
DE-MC_Z: (default: 3) number of different chains to employ.
        DREAM: (default: 7)
        MCMC: (default: 1)

burnIn.desc: DE-MC_Z: (default: 100) number of iterations (meaning draws / nChains) to do before doing actual sampling.

DEpairs.desc: DE-MC_Z: (default: 1) number of pairs of chains to base movements off of.

eps.desc:
DE-MC_Z: (default: 5e-2) used in jittering the chains.
        DREAM: (default: 10e-6)

freq.desc: eFAST: (default: cukier) indicates weather to use the frequencies after 'cukier' or McRae 'mcrae'.

logscale.desc:
eFAST: (default: None (= np.nan)) array containing bool values indicating weather a parameter is varied
    on a logarithmic scale. In that case minimum and maximum are exponents.

kpow.desc: FSCABC: (default: 4) exponent for power scaling method.

repetitions_first_run.desc: ROPE: (default: None) Number of runs in the first rune.

subsets.desc: ROPE: (default: 5) number of time the rope algorithm creates a smaller search windows for parameters.

percentage_first_run.desc: ROPE: (default: 0.1) amount of runs that will be used for the next step after the first subset

percentage_following_runs.desc: ROPE: (default: 0.1) amount of runs that will be used for the next step after in all following subsets.

NDIR.desc: ROPE: (default: None) The number of samples to draw.

info.name: split string
info.description: Splits a string along delimiter.

info.name: split string2
info.description: Splits a string along delimiter.

info.name: Collect into list
info.description: Collects values (parsed out of a string) into a list.

no_of_elements.desc: Number of elements to collect into array. no_of_elements <= 0 means collect all elements from upstream. This means the component waits for the 'in' port to close, before sending a message on out.

cast_to.desc: Cast received value on 'in' port to either text, float or int values.

info.name: to string
info.description: Outputs input structures as string (if possible).

struct_type.desc: A Cap'n Proto content type string with a struct schema id (e.g. '@0xed6c098b67cad454 = common/common.capnp:StructuredText') or 'Text' for plain text content. If the incoming IP has a parseable sysAttributes.contentType, that schema takes precedence over this configured value.
